summary: Master B2B consultative selling with MEDDICC, SPIN, and CRM-based practice. Improve discovery, value framing, and account growth.
lede: B2B consultative selling gives sales and revenue professionals a structured way to diagnose buyer needs and move complex opportunities forward. Learners practice qualifying deals, mapping stakeholder influence, and conducting discovery conversations, then frame solutions around buyer priorities. Exercises also cover objection responses, account growth planning, and CRM-based pipeline and forecast reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for commercially active professionals who need to improve how they diagnose buyer needs, qualify opportunities, and move accounts through complex decisions. It fits sales and revenue roles working in relationship-led or solution-led B2B environments.
prerequisites: You will need a laptop for note-taking, worksheet completion, and CRM-style exercises. Bring a recent deal, account, or proposal case if possible, along with familiarity with your organization’s sales stages and basic customer data.
